name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Log Size
details: For every finite binary class $\mathcal H$ with $\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)\geq2$, $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)\geq\log_2|\mathcal H|/(2\log_2\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H))$.
proof: Put $d=\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)$.  Padding a width-$d$ no-clashing teacher gives each concept a labeled sample on exactly $d$ of the $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$ effective coordinates.  Distinct concepts receive distinct samples, so $|\mathcal H|\leq2^d\binom{\mathrm E(\mathcal H)}d\leq(2\mathrm E(\mathcal H))^d$.  Taking binary logarithms and using $1+\log_2\mathrm E\leq2\log_2\mathrm E$ gives the claim.
proof_source: Proposition prop:nctd-low-log-size in the LaTeX survey.
